Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

On `main`, `GanttConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `strictObject`, closed against unknown keys) declares no `scale` key; its granularity key is `viewMode: z.enum(['day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year'])`. - `Clause-②: no` in the PR body and the changeset — right: no accept-set widening or narrowing, no removed or renamed authorable key, no ADR-0087 disposition marker owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev `open_questions`: none filed. Nothing to answer.
- Out-of-scope finding 1 (`packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:13763`): **confirmed.** The line sits under `## 17.1.0` (heading at `:12647`), the retirement is `retiredAfter: '17.4.0'` with spec at `17.4.0` and no CHANGELOG entry for it yet, so the sentence was true when published and describes that release's own change. AGENTS.md § Documentation Guardrails marks `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` release-owned (never edited in a code PR; a factual error in a released entry is a dedicated docs-only PR). Not a factual error; leaving it is right.
- Out-of-scope finding 2 (`.changeset/19992-currency-config-precision-retired.md`): **confirmed.** Its "unchanged" is the field-level `precision` (total digit count), matching the retirement entry's own `replacement` text.
- Dev's one NOT MEASURED local gate (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, prerequisite build): the owning CI population, `Build Core`, is success on the head. Closed.
- **Unflagged by the dev, the FAIL reason:** the gantt `scale` clause (① above). The fix is text only, in the sentence this diff already rewrites: name the surface that exists — the timeline `scale` enum (`TimelineConfigSchema.scale`) — or drop the clause; then `gen:migration-registry`; no tracker number in the text. If the owning seat rules that clause outside #20379's scope, the alternative is a sibling card before this head is re-reviewed — but a PASS record cannot certify author-shown text that sends authors to a key a strict schema refuses.
- Nine check-runs had not concluded at poll time (named in ①); a re-review on a new head reads them afresh.
